name: Depreciation and amortization
description: Sum of depreciation of fixed assets, depletion of oil and gas assets, depreciation of productive biological assets, amortization of intangible assets, and amortization of long-term deferred expenses

name: Cash and cash equivalents
description: Sum of cash on hand, deposits in bank settlement accounts, deposits in other locations, bank draft deposits, bank cashier’s check deposits, credit card deposits, letter-of-credit margin deposits, and similar items

name: Net accounts receivable
description: Difference between accounts receivable and the bad-debt provision for accounts receivable

name: Net inventory
description: Difference between “inventory” and “inventory write-down provision”

name: Total current assets
description: Sum of all current asset items

name: Net fixed assets
description: Original cost of fixed assets net of accumulated depreciation and the impairment provision for fixed assets

name: Total assets
description: Total of all asset items

name: Accounts payable
description: Amounts payable to suppliers for raw materials, goods, or services received

name: Taxes payable
description: Various taxes and fees payable as calculated under tax law and related rules, including value-added tax, consumption tax, business tax, income tax, and others

name: Total current liabilities
description: Sum of all current liability items

name: Total non-current liabilities
description: Sum of all non-current liabilities

name: Total liabilities
description: Total of all liability items

name: Paid-in capital
description: Difference between the total share capital invested by shareholders under the articles of association and the investment already returned

name: Retained earnings
description: Sum of surplus reserves and undistributed profit

name: Long-term debt balance
description: Sum of long-term borrowings, bonds payable, long-term payables, and special payables

name: Short-term debt
description: Sum of short-term borrowings, notes payable, non-current liabilities due within one year, and other payables

name: Net long-term investment
description: Sum of long-term equity investment and long-term debt investment

name: Outstanding shares
description: Total shares tradable in the secondary market

name: Year-end closing price
description: Closing price on the last trading day of each year

name: Operating revenue
description: Operating revenue recognized in the course of business operations

name: Operating cost
description: Operating cost recognized by the firm

name: Financial expense
description: Expenses incurred to raise the funds needed for production and operations

name: Income tax expense
description: Income tax expense to be deducted from total profit for the current period

name: Net profit
description: Net profit realized by the firm

name: Gross profit
description: Difference between operating revenue and operating cost
